\chapter{Introduction}
\label{\detokenize{index:introduction}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Models is the result of the Thesis of FratosVR. In this repository you can find the code and documentation of the project.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This includes the code to train and use models to detect gestures made by a person using a mocap suit. This are simple models to ensure easy and fast computation.


\chapter{Installation}
\label{\detokenize{index:installation}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
To install the packages needed to run and train the models, you can use the following command:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textasciigrave{}bash
pip install \sphinxhyphen{}r requirements.txt
\textasciigrave{}}}


\chapter{Usage}
\label{\detokenize{index:usage}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Step by step guide on how to train the models:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Download a valid dataset}: ensure that the dataset is from a mocap suit and contains the necessary data for training.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Launch the interface}: run \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textasciigrave{}python Interface.py\textasciigrave{}}} to open the web interface.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Select the dataset}: in the interface, choose the dataset you downloaded in step 1.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Select the model}: choose the model you want to train from the available options.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Train the model}: click on the “Train” button to start the training process. The interface will show the progress and results of the training.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Evaluate the model}: after training, you can evaluate the model’s performance using the provided metrics in the interface.

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxAtStartPar
You can add new models by creating a new class with the same structure as the existing ones. Make sure to implement the necessary methods and follow the naming conventions used in the project.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Generate and save a confusion matrix visualization.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Creates a heatmap\sphinxhyphen{}style confusion matrix with class labels, grid lines,
and value annotations in each cell. Saves the plot to specified file.
\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{y}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{np.ndarray}}) \textendash{} Ground truth class indices (0\sphinxhyphen{}based or 1\sphinxhyphen{}based)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{p}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{np.ndarray}}) \textendash{} Predicted class indices (same indexing as y)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{tags}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{list}}\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{{[}}}\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{str}}\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{{]}}}) \textendash{} Class names corresponding to indices

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{filename}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{str}}) \textendash{} Output file path for saving the plot

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{title}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{str}}\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{, }}\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{optional}}) \textendash{} Optional title for the plot, defaults to “”

\end{itemize}

\end{description}\end{quote}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Note:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Handles both 0\sphinxhyphen{}based and 1\sphinxhyphen{}based class indexing automatically

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Uses red color gradient (Reds colormap) for the heatmap

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Includes grid lines between cells for better readability

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Text annotations are white/black for optimal contrast

\end{itemize}

\end{description}

\end{fulllineitems}
